items.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many

items.title: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied
items.desc: Families in Gaza are bracing for a fourth winter in tents and makeshift shelters as UN aid operations face mounting obstacles, with transport suspended on Tuesday due to Israel’s closure of the key Kerem Shalom crossing for election day.

items.title: West Bank: Hebron crackdown displaces thousands, Türk warns of ethnic cleansing
items.desc: Israel’s “aggressive operation” in the West Bank city of Hebron raises serious concerns of ethnic cleansing, UN human rights chief Volker Türk warned on Monday, as the number of Palestinians forced from their homes passed 3,000 on the eve of Israeli elections.

items.title: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
items.desc: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.

items.title: Yemen: Deepening concerns for Taiz City as aid is blocked from entering
items.desc: Aid agencies warned on Friday of the fast-developing humanitarian emergency inside Taiz City in Yemen, which has been encircled by de facto Houthi forces fighting government troops along the country’s west coast.
